triggers.help: This trigger can be activated from the Webhooks settings in Funraise. Use this to trigger recipes based off transactions in Funraise by passing the Webhook URL below to the WEBHOOK TARGET URL in Funraise. Webhook URL Connect to Funraise to get Webhook URL.
